request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. A tiny safe-rest lullaby. Slow augmented D-A-B-NATURAL motif, its minor second becomes a major second, comforting but never a triumphant cadence. One warm soft bronze handbell with delicate harp harmonics; moss absorbs the resonance. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
